summary: Create A Material Master Record For A New Api With A Defined Shelf-Lif

acceptanceCriteria.text: The user can access the "Manage Material Master" Fiori app.
The system requires the batch management indicator to be set for materials flagged as GMP-regulated in the material type configuration.
The system requires entry of total shelf life and minimum remaining shelf life on the Plant Data / Storage view.
The system requires an assigned Quality Management inspection type for GMP-relevant materials.
The material record cannot be released for procurement until all mandatory GMP fields are completed.
A change log captures all subsequent modifications to regulatory-relevant fields for audit purposes.

HP.description: Create complete GMP-regulated API Material Master with all mandatory fields including batch management indicator, total shelf life, minimum remaining shelf life, and QM inspection type; verify material is released for procurement and change log is generated

NEG.description: Attempt to create GMP material without setting batch management indicator
Attempt to create GMP material without assigning QM inspection type
Attempt to release material for procurement with incomplete GMP fields (missing shelf-life or QM type)

ERR.description: Missing Total Shelf Life on Plant Data/Storage view
Missing Minimum Remaining Shelf Life on Plant Data/Storage view
Missing Batch Management Indicator for GMP material
Missing QM Inspection Type for GMP material

EDGE.description: Total Shelf Life = 3650 days (maximum boundary, typical system limit)
Minimum Remaining Shelf Life = 1 day (minimum boundary)
Minimum Remaining Shelf Life = Total Shelf Life - 1 (maximum valid boundary)
Minimum Remaining Shelf Life = Total Shelf Life (invalid — should fail validation)

input.name: materialType
input.label: Material Type
input.validRange: Must be GMP-regulated type (e.g., FERT, HALB, ROH with GMP flag in config)

input.name: materialNumber
input.label: Material
input.validRange: Unique identifier; auto-generated if internal numbering enabled

input.name: materialDescription
input.label: Material Description
input.validRange: Max 40 characters (short text) or 80 characters (long text)

input.name: baseUnitOfMeasure
input.label: Base Unit of Measure
input.validRange: Valid UoM from SAP T006 (e.g., KG, L, PC, EA)

input.name: batchManagementIndicator
input.label: Batch Management
input.validRange: True/False; must be True for GMP materials

input.name: plant
input.label: Plant
input.validRange: Valid plant code from SAP T001W

input.name: storageLocation
input.label: Storage Location
input.validRange: Valid storage location for the plant from SAP T001L

input.name: qmInspectionType
input.label: QM Inspection Type
input.validRange: Valid QM inspection type from SAP quality management configuration

autoPopulated.name: valuationClass
autoPopulated.label: Valuation Class
autoPopulated.source: Material type and plant combination in config

output.name: materialNumber
output.label: Material Number
output.format: Alphanumeric, length varies by numbering range config (e.g., 18-digit for internal, custom for external)

output.name: createdBy
output.label: Created By
output.description: User ID who created the material

output.name: changeLogEntry
output.label: Change Log Entry
output.description: Audit log record for each modification to regulatory-relevant fields
output.format: Table entry in change documents (CDHDR/CDPOS) containing: Material, Field Name, Old Value, New Value, Change Date, Changed By

boundary.name: minimumRemainingShelfLife
boundary.label: Min. Remaining Shelf Life
boundary.upperBoundary: Total Shelf Life - 1 (must be less than total)
boundary.notes: Must be positive integer and < Total Shelf Life

boundary.name: materialDescriptionShort
boundary.label: Material Description (short text)
boundary.notes: Length constraint per SAP field MAKTX
